policy.start: PUBLIC_MEAN exactly; no fitted vector or alternate seed
policy.metric: full G + diag(KERNEL_PRECISION); no eigenvalue or covariance repair
policy.scaled_metric: B * outer(PUBLIC_SD,PUBLIC_SD), one symmetric outer-product scale
policy.arithmetic: fsum of computed products; explicit eta terms and upward directional/model/final guards. Stored/computed operands only, no real-model/libm/derivative certificate.
policy.counts: Every objective/gradient evaluation including one forced final verification; constant Hessian requests do not evaluate objective or prior.
policy.uncertainty: No posterior covariance, intervals, coverage or nonlinear stationarity inferred

current_block.gradient_and_gram_coordinates: unscaled entering x; residual=prediction-observed; sigma whitening once
current_block.curvature_semantics: undamped full Gauss-Newton Gram, not the exact likelihood Hessian or a posterior

roundoff.method: Neumaier compensated sum and compensated absolute summand sum
roundoff.scope: Absolute scales describe computed binary64 residual/Jacobian summands. They do not bound libm, recurrence, derivative, subtraction, whitening or product error against a real-model evaluation. No full-model error certificate is claimed.

current_block.endpoint_derivative_layout: full-row-major 16x16; rows endpoint_x, columns entering x
current_block.endpoint_physical_derivative_layout: full-row-major 16x16; rows endpoint_state, columns entering x

storage.limitations: Workspace is fixed automatic storage. This sizeof accounting excludes other scalar/pointer stack frames, unchanged model function stack, compiler spills, FILE/libc/libm storage, executable code, process/runtime and externally retained observations. It is not complete target SRAM or a measured stack peak.
